step1_analysis.description: A fully differential folded cascode OTA with a PMOS input pair and continuous-time common-mode feedback. It is designed for low-voltage operation and is likely used as the core amplifier in the integrators of the sigma-delta modulator.

paper_reference.title: A Low-Voltage Low-Power Sigma-Delta Modulator for Broadband Analog-to-Digital Conversion

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rout. With W/L=10, Id~40uA, gm~200uA/V, ro~250kOhm. Rout ~ gm*ro^2/2 ~ 6 MOhm. Gain ~ 1200 V/V ~ 61 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the exact bias currents and output resistance in SKY130. The paper's 89 dB might have used gain boosting or longer channels, so a standard folded cascode in 130nm will typically yield 60-70 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm / (2*pi*Cload). gm ~ 200uA/V, Cload = 1pF -> UGBW ~ 31 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The OTA bandwidth must be significantly higher than the ADC signal bandwidth (1.25 MHz) to ensure proper settling in the sigma-delta modulator integrators.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the non-dominant pole at the folded node (N0, N4). With small parasitic capacitance, PM should be high.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard requirement for stable closed-loop integrator operation.

Power_Consumption.description: Total static power dissipation of the OTA

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = VDD * I_total. I_total ~ 3 * 40uA = 120uA. Power = 1.8V * 120uA = 216 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The OTA consumes a fraction of the total ADC power. Adjusted for 1.8V supply in SKY130.

Slew_Rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage

sky130_expected.reasoning: Critical for large-signal settling in switched-capacitor or continuous-time integrators.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for Folded Cascode OTA measuring DC Gain, UGBW, Phase Margin, Power, and Slew Rate.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Folded Cascode OTA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

XM2 N4 VIN2 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 N0 VIN1 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM3 VOUT1 VB2 N10 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 CMFB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 CMFB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N7 VB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 VOUT2 VB2 N7 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 VOUT2 VB3 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 VOUT1 VB3 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N10 VB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N2 VB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Bias Voltages
VVB1 VB1 0 1.0
VVB2 VB2 0 0.6
VVB3 VB3 0 1.0

* Ideal CMFB to set output common-mode to 0.9V
Ecmfb CMFB 0 VALUE = {0.6 + 10*(v(VOUT1) + v(VOUT2) - 1.8)}

* Input Signals (DC, AC, and Transient Pulse)
VVIN1 VIN1 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 PULSE(0.9 1.0 10n 1n 1n 1u 2u)
VVIN2 VIN2 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 PULSE(0.9 0.8 10n 1n 1n 1u 2u)

* Load Capacitors
C1 VOUT1 0 1p
C2 VOUT2 0 1p

* Differential Output (VOUT2 - VOUT1 to ensure 0 deg DC phase)
Eout VOUT_DIFF 0 VALUE={v(VOUT2)-v(VOUT1)}

.control
  * DC Operating Point and Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1 1G
  let gain_db = vdb(VOUT_DIFF)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VOUT_DIFF))
  let pm = 180 + phase
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_margin find pm when gain_db=0 fall=1

  * Transient Analysis for Slew Rate
  tran 0.1n 50n
  * Measure time to slew from 0.2V to 0.8V differential
  meas tran t_rise trig v(VOUT_DIFF) val=0.2 rise=1 targ v(VOUT_DIFF) val=0.8 rise=1
  let sr_v_us = 0.6 / t_rise / 1e6
  print sr_v_us

  quit
.endc
